description: This file implements network interface and address management functionalities, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems. It handles network interface enumeration, address addition/removal, route management, and interface status checks, with classes and methods for iterating over network adapters and addresses.
external_files: <system headers depending on platform: e.g., <WS2tcpip.h>, <iphlpapi.h> for Windows; <arpa/inet.h>, <ifaddrs.h> for POSIX>

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to check status, enable/disable, add/delete addresses, and manage gateways.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to their properties such as name, MAC address, and status.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing the collection of network interfaces and their addresses, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: RoutingTable::Route
classes.description: Represents a network route with source, destination, gateway, interface, and other attributes.

classes.name: AdapterObserver::INotification
classes.description: Interface for callback notifications related to network adapter events.

methods.name: Network::IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is up.

methods.name: Network::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is running.

methods.name: Network::Up
methods.description: Enables or disables the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Gateway
methods.description: Sets a gateway for a network.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::HasMAC
methods.description: Checks if the current adapter has a valid MAC address.
